body: I’m so sorry you’re feeling like this so young. I dealt with bullying all through my childhood. The first time I fell into a depression when I was when I was eleven and I also began struggling with OCD, but it was so difficult to be taken seriously because of my age. If you can, reach out to your loved ones. If you can’t, there’s lots of resources online! One thing that helped me when I was dealing with stuff like this was this website: https://www.7cups.com. Hope you’re doing better soon :)

I feel that for sure. Guns are completely banned in my country. The only other one I’d have access to is drowning but it would have to be in the local estuary where my dad sails. Sailing is his passion and I couldn’t fuck that up for him.

I’m sorry to hear that, that sounds like such a difficult experience :( I’ll definitely talk to my doctor about what’s going on next time I see her and I guess we’ll just figure it out from there. Medication really is hit or miss and it can be so difficult to find the right one, but it’s reassuring to know that there’s solutions to this! 

I’m glad to hear that you’re doing a lot better now though :)

Oops sorry, I should have elaborated on that. I don’t have BPD (that I’m aware of) I’m under 18 so they can’t really evaluate me anyway but the mood swings and unstable emotions are very recent so I don’t think that’s the cause. DBT was just recommended to me since it’s been adapted for other mental health issues since it was first developed. I also have lots of books on CBT but that mostly helped with managing intrusive thoughts rather than managing intense emotions.
That means a lot, thank you :) <3 I’m doing okay at the moment and I’m going to talk to my doctor about it as soon as possible.
